service: EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Intelligence Radar
description: Extracts and scores European Union public procurement notices and contract awards from the official EU TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) portal. Enriches CPV codes, contracting authorities, EUR contract values, deadlines, and Bid Opportunity Scores.

inputSchema.title: EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Intelligence Radar Input
inputSchema.description: Configure procurement keyword, optional 3-letter EU Member State ISO code (e.g., DEU, FRA, ESP, NLD), and maximum EU TED notices to extract and score.

searchKeyword.title: Procurement Keyword / Sector
searchKeyword.description: Public tender topic, CPV keyword, or technology sector (e.g., 'Cloud Cybersecurity', 'Artificial Intelligence', 'Medical Devices', 'Solar Energy').

countryIso3.title: EU Country ISO-3 Code (Optional)
countryIso3.description: Optional 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., 'DEU', 'FRA', 'ESP', 'ITA', 'NLD', 'BEL', or leave empty for all EU/EEA member states).

maxResults.title: Maximum Tenders to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of European public procurement notices to extract and score (1 to 100).

publicationNumber.title: EU TED Publication Number
publicationNumber.description: Official Supplement to the Official Journal of the EU (OJ S) notice ID.

noticeTitle.title: Tender / Contract Title
noticeTitle.description: Official title of the public procurement notice.

buyerName.title: Contracting Authority (Buyer)
buyerName.description: European ministry, agency, or public utility issuing the tender.

buyerCountryIso3.title: Buyer Country (ISO-3)
buyerCountryIso3.description: 3-letter ISO code of the contracting authority country.

cpvCode.title: Primary CPV Code
cpvCode.description: 8-digit EU Common Procurement Vocabulary classification code.

procedureType.title: Procurement Procedure Type
procedureType.description: Open, Restricted, Competitive Dialogue, or Framework Agreement.

publicationDate.title: Publication Date
publicationDate.description: ISO date when the notice was published on EU TED.

deadlineDate.title: Submission Deadline Date
deadlineDate.description: ISO deadline for submitting bids or requests to participate.

estimatedValueEur.title: Estimated Contract Value (EUR)
estimatedValueEur.description: Estimated or awarded contract value in Euros (EUR).

bidOpportunityScore.title: Bid Opportunity Score (0-100)
bidOpportunityScore.description: Quantitative B2G capture score combining contract value, open procedure openness, and CPV match (0-100).

markdownProcurementBrief.title: Markdown B2G Capture & Proposal Brief
markdownProcurementBrief.description: Executive Markdown brief for European B2G capture teams and automated RFP pipelines.

overview.title: EU TED Public Tenders & B2G Procurement Overview

x402Challenge.error: Payment Required: Submit a valid Solana USDC transfer proof in the X-PAYMENT header.
